meta.script:
"""L3 用（1 回限り）: 削除前の Python の convert-pkl（ml/src/ml_train/legacy_pkl）と試験の生成器（ml/tests/legacy_support.py）で、
合成の旧モデル pickle と、Python 版の判定・変換結果を固定する。実 pkl ではない（旧 jraev を import せず、同名の空クラスで作る）。
生成物: <out>/expected.json（各 pickle は Base64 で埋め込む。.gitignore の *.pkl を緩めない。生成元コミット・版・本スクリプトの全文を含む）。"""
import base64, hashlib, json, os, pickle, platform, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
REPO = Path(sys.argv[1]); OUT = Path(sys.argv[2])
sys.path[:0] = [str(REPO / "ml" / "src"), str(REPO / "ml"), str(REPO)]
from tests.legacy_support import legacy_pickle, _fake_module
from ml_train.legacy_pkl.unpickle import load_legacy_model, UnpickleRefused
from ml_train.legacy_pkl.convert import convert, KnownSchemas, ConversionRefused, sha256_of
from tools.ml import canonical

schemas = KnownSchemas.load(REPO / "domain" / "src" / "test" / "resources" / "ml")
cases = {}
for kind in ("market5", "calibration40", "alpha35"):
    for proto in (2, 3, 4, 5):
        cases[(f"refused_{kind}_p2_codecs" if proto == 2 else f"valid_{kind}_p{proto}")] = legacy_pickle(kind=kind, protocol=proto)
cases["valid_float32_weights"] = legacy_pickle(kind="calibration40", weights=np.array([0.5, -0.25] * 20, dtype=np.float32))
cases["valid_big_endian_weights"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", weights=np.array([0.5, -0.25, 1.0, 2.0, -3.5], dtype=">f8"))
cases["valid_no_calibration"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", calib_a=None, calib_b=None)
o = _fake_module()(); o.__dict__.update({"weights": np.array([0.1]*5), "bias": -1.0, "feature_names": ["odds","popularity","log_odds","inv_popularity","odds_popularity_interaction"]})
cases["valid_minimal_attributes"] = pickle.dumps(o, protocol=4)
cases["valid_numpy_scalars"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", bias=np.float64(-0.5), calib_a=np.float32(1.5), market_blend_alpha=np.float64(0.75))
cases["valid_int_bias"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", bias=2, market_blend_alpha=1)
cases["refused_half_calibration"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", calib_b=None)
cases["refused_dimension_mismatch"] = legacy_pickle(kind="calibration40", dim=35)
cases["refused_unknown_schema"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", feature_names=["a","b","c","d","e"])
cases["refused_duplicate_names"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", feature_names=["odds"]*5)
cases["refused_nan_weight"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", weights=np.array([0.1, float("nan"), 0.1, 0.1, 0.1]))
cases["refused_inf_bias"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", bias=float("inf"))
cases["refused_string_bias"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", bias="1.0")
cases["refused_bool_bias"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", bias=True)
cases["refused_blend_out_of_range"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", market_blend_alpha=1.5)
cases["refused_2d_weights"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", weights=np.zeros((5, 1)))
cases["refused_int_weights"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", weights=np.arange(5, dtype=np.int64))
cases["refused_object_weights"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", weights=np.array([0.1]*5, dtype=object))
cases["refused_list_weights"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", weights=[0.1]*5)
cases["refused_unknown_attribute"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", extra_attr=1)
o = _fake_module()(); o.__dict__.update({"bias": -1.0, "feature_names": ["odds"]})
cases["refused_missing_weights"] = pickle.dumps(o, protocol=4)
class Evil:
    def __reduce__(self): return (os.system, ("echo PWNED",))
cases["refused_os_system"] = pickle.dumps(Evil(), protocol=4)
cases["refused_os_system_inside_model"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5", feature_names=Evil())
cases["refused_eval"] = pickle.dumps(type("E", (), {"__reduce__": lambda s: (eval, ("1+1",))})(), protocol=2)
cases["refused_plain_dict"] = pickle.dumps({"weights": [0.1]}, protocol=4)
import types
sys.modules["other"] = types.ModuleType("other"); m = types.ModuleType("other.model"); sys.modules["other.model"] = m
class WinProbabilityModel: pass
WinProbabilityModel.__module__ = "other.model"; m.WinProbabilityModel = WinProbabilityModel
o = WinProbabilityModel(); o.__dict__.update({"weights": np.array([0.1]*5), "bias": 0.0, "feature_names": ["odds"]})
cases["refused_other_module_same_name"] = pickle.dumps(o, protocol=4)
cases["refused_ext_opcode"] = b"\x80\x02\x82\x01."
cases["refused_persid"] = b"\x80\x02Pabc\n."
cases["refused_truncated"] = legacy_pickle(kind="market5")[:-20]
cases["refused_empty"] = b""

OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
expected = {}
for name, data in sorted(cases.items()):
    e = {"sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "pickle_b64": base64.b64encode(data).decode()}
    try:
        shell = load_legacy_model(data)
        c = convert(shell, schemas=schemas, model_id="legacy-001", tenant_id=1, created_at="2026-11-02T00:00:00Z", source_sha256=sha256_of(data))
        e["outcome"] = "CONVERTED"; e["model_json"] = canonical.dumps(c.model).decode(); e["warnings"] = c.warnings
    except UnpickleRefused as x:
        e["outcome"] = "REFUSED"; e["reason"] = "PICKLE_" + x.reason
    except ConversionRefused as x:
        e["outcome"] = "REFUSED"; e["reason"] = x.reason
    expected[name] = e
sha = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
meta = {"generator": "gen_pkl_fixtures.py (L3, 1 回限り)", "source_commit": sha, "python": platform.python_version(), "numpy": np.__version__,
        "note": "合成の旧モデル pickle（実 pkl ではない）と、削除前の Python 版 convert-pkl の判定・出力。Kotlin 版はこの判定と出力（producer を除く）に一致させる",
        "script": Path(__file__).read_text()}
(OUT / "expected.json").write_text(json.dumps({"meta": meta, "cases": expected}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
print({k: (v["outcome"], v.get("reason")) for k, v in expected.items()})
